unit: v1.3 fix hints: mechanical validity on the 71-case development set (Docs/v1.3/fix-hints.md §4). DEVELOPMENT-SET numbers, not a hold-out estimate
neo4j: Neo4j 5.26.0 Community + APOC 5.26.0 core from the release tarballs (dist.neo4j.org, github.com/neo4j/apoc), bolt 127.0.0.1:7699, local scratch instance; no --engine cypher-interp exists in this repository

byteIdentity: default CLI output (no --hints), json and human, all 71 variants, this branch vs an origin/v1.3 worktree on the same Neo4j: 142/142 identical after masking runId, durationMs, executionTimeMs, totalMs and the human Duration line
